entries.title: Job 36:1
segments: Elihu also proceeded, and said,

entries.title: Job 36:2
segments: Suffer me a little, and I will show thee; For I have yet somewhat to say on God's behalf.

entries.title: Job 36:3
segments: I will fetch my knowledge from afar, And will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.

entries.title: Job 36:4
segments: For truly my words are not false: One that is perfect in knowledge is with thee.

entries.title: Job 36:5
segments: Behold, God is mighty, and despiseth not any: He is mighty in strength of understanding.

entries.title: Job 36:6
segments: He preserveth not the life of the wicked, But giveth to the afflicted [their] right.

entries.title: Job 36:7
segments: He withdraweth not his eyes from the righteous: But with kings upon the throne He setteth them for ever, and they are exalted.

entries.title: Job 36:8
segments: And if they be bound in fetters, And be taken in the cords of afflictions;

entries.title: Job 36:9
segments: Then he showeth them their work, And their transgressions, that they have behaved themselves proudly.

entries.title: Job 36:10
segments: He openeth also their ear to instruction, And commandeth that they return from iniquity.

entries.title: Job 36:11
segments: If they hearken and serve [him], They shall spend their days in prosperity, And their years in pleasures.

entries.title: Job 36:12
segments: But if they hearken not, they shall perish by the sword, And they shall die without knowledge.

entries.title: Job 36:13
segments: But they that are godless in heart lay up anger: They cry not for help when he bindeth them.

entries.title: Job 36:14
segments: They die in youth, And their life [perisheth] among the unclean.

entries.title: Job 36:15
segments: He delivereth the afflicted by their affliction, And openeth their ear in oppression.

entries.title: Job 36:16
segments: Yea, he would have allured thee out of distress Into a broad place, where there is no straitness; And that which is set on thy table would be full of fatness.

entries.title: Job 36:17
segments: But thou art full of the judgment of the wicked: Judgment and justice take hold [on thee].

entries.title: Job 36:18
segments: For let not wrath stir thee up against chastisements; Neither let the greatness of the ransom turn thee aside.

entries.title: Job 36:19
segments: Will thy cry avail, [that thou be] not in distress, Or all the forces of [thy] strength?

entries.title: Job 36:20
segments: Desire not the night, When peoples are cut off in their place.

entries.title: Job 36:21
segments: Take heed, regard not iniquity: For this hast thou chosen rather than affliction.

entries.title: Job 36:22
segments: Behold, God doeth loftily in his power: Who is a teacher like unto him?

entries.title: Job 36:23
segments: Who hath enjoined him his way? Or who can say, Thou hast wrought unrighteousness?

entries.title: Job 36:24
segments: Remember that thou magnify his work, Whereof men have sung.

entries.title: Job 36:25
segments: All men have looked thereon; Man beholdeth it afar off.

entries.title: Job 36:26
segments: Behold, God is great, and we know him not; The number of his years is unsearchable.

entries.title: Job 36:27
segments: For he draweth up the drops of water, Which distil in rain from his vapor,

entries.title: Job 36:28
segments: Which the skies pour down And drop upon man abundantly.

entries.title: Job 36:29
segments: Yea, can any understand the spreadings of the clouds, The thunderings of his pavilion?

entries.title: Job 36:30
segments: Behold, he spreadeth his light around him; And he covereth the bottom of the sea.

entries.title: Job 36:31
segments: For by these he judgeth the peoples; He giveth food in abundance.

entries.title: Job 36:32
segments: He covereth his hands with the lightning, And giveth it a charge that it strike the mark.

entries.title: Job 36:33
segments: The noise thereof telleth concerning him, The cattle also concerning [the storm] that cometh up.
